about: README's first screen, design (board item RA, release gate item 6): an audit of OPENING's body (version 12; lines 1 to 58 byte-identical to drafts/2026-10-10-opening/history/OPENING-V12.md at c3a2f0fc4) against AGENTS, the glossary and chapters 7 and 8; two drafts of the four points (A and B); two cold readers, a newcomer and an alignment researcher, judging both drafts and where the block goes. Opus agents, AI-written, run 2026-10-31. The landed screen is draft B with the readers' edits and the later review's fixes (README-FIRST-SCREEN.md).
draftA:
*About a minute to read. AI-written; the opening below is in the first person.*

The Theory of Becoming is an account of how anything comes to be, lasts, changes and passes away within one relational unfolding, and of how life, knowing and evaluation take shape inside it, without assuming that becoming is good.

**What is tested.** Its laws are proved in Lean: 475 of the 506 registered results carry a recorded Lean receipt. On the pure core every source declaration has an empty axiom report. That concerns the logic only; the representation's commitments, such as discrete steps and whole-number amounts, are premises of the laws that use them.

**Two premises, neither asserted.** The ethics rests on the continuation condition, that for anything its continuation has significance, which fixes whose losses count, and on C, that widening what can form is better, which alone orders.

**Where to start:** [the one page](theories/becoming/ONE-PAGE.md) (17–22 minutes), [the overview](theories/becoming/THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md) (104–135 minutes), [the eight chapters](theories/becoming/chapters/README.md) and [the register](RESULTS.md). The opening below states a conviction (19–25 minutes); each note gives its sentence's standing.
draftB:
*AI-written; a minute to read.*

**What it is.** An account of how anything comes to be, lasts, changes and passes away within one relational unfolding, life and evaluation included, without assuming becoming is good.

**The ethics** rests on [two premises](theories/becoming/chapters/07-SIGNIFICANCE.md#scope-and-order), neither asserted: the continuation condition (for anything, its continuation has significance) fixes scope, whose losses count; C (widening what can form is better) alone gives order. Their warrant is open, and none binding every possible mind is claimed; its results are theorems under the premises each names.

**Where to start.** [The one page](theories/becoming/ONE-PAGE.md), 17–22 minutes, then [the overview](theories/becoming/THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md), 104–135 minutes; [the opening](#truth-exists) below, 19–25 minutes; [its notes](#notes), about 80–100 more.

**What is tested.** 475 of [506 registered results](RESULTS.md) have a recorded Lean receipt. [The theses](theories/becoming/chapters/08-METHOD.md#theses) about actual systems face frozen tests: some passed, some failed. No human has yet reviewed the work, only machines.

audit.summary:
I audited OPENING.md lines 5–57 against AGENTS.md, GLOSSARY.md, 07-SIGNIFICANCE.md (§1, §3, §4.1–4.6, T8, Open) and 08-METHOD.md (§2, §3, retired labels). Lines 1–58 of the file are byte-identical to drafts/2026-10-10-opening/history/OPENING-V12.md. So the body is still version 12 of 22 October, and it predates four changes to the account. The root became the grammar of relations on 23 October (RA). Chapter 7 §4.6 added a path that reaches part of the scope without the step, with P2 and P4 as its crux (PF, 24–25 October). DF1b ruled on 26 October that Landauer's bound is no floor of lost work by itself. LW, on 30 October, put T8 in its stance form, "For life, the way is 生生", claimed no verdict binding every possible mind, and restated the goal; Ren approved the new goal.

Three sentences contradict the current account for a reader of the body alone:
- the ethics offered "for all beings, in all universes";
- the line "between good and evil", with nothing scoping it to life;
- the least loss holding wherever an exchange "forgets".

One passage contradicts it in part: "That takes one step" together with "our first open question", because §4.6's path now reaches part of the scope without the step.

Four sentences are older but their notes correct them:
- "None of this needs an axiom": the note limits it to logic, and the second-law reading is proved in the periphery with Lean's standard axioms;
- reactions "as theorems": the note calls this a modelling correspondence;
- the optimizer sentence: it omits the room hypothesis, which the note states;
- the closing question itself: its note corrects it only in part.

The other items are style only.

Several AI-written notes are also older, and they change on the AI side next to any proposal:
- [^ethics] still opens "Open: this is the claim the work sets out to prove", but the goal was restated on 30 October.
- [^axiom] does not mention §4.6's path, P2 or P4, or that the ethics does not wait on a universal warrant. It still says the attempt with no axiom "has not yet begun".
- [^good-evil] never says "for life".
- [^own] grounds what living beings act on in the continuation condition instead of P1, the self's presupposition, which the condition contains.

For the README first-screen block, this means two things. First, the body already names both premises by role ("that one step to say whose losses count", "to order them"), so the block can say the same without repeating the body. Second, the block's own statements on scope (for life, no verdict binding every possible mind) and on what an empty axiom report shows (logic only, not the modelling choices) state current terms the body lacks. By the coordinator's condition (2), each needs a proposal to OPENING (items 1, 2 and 5 below) to go alongside. The proposals keep Ren's voice, and none changes a sentence that already matches the account.

older.sentence: This law, with that one step to say whose losses count, and, to order them, what anyone who counts everything at stake as worth something already holds, that what keeps all there was and adds more is better, is offered as the basis of all ethics, for all beings, in all universes.
older.current_terms: T8 (07 §8): "For life, the way is 生生 ... It is the way of those whose own line runs through life, of whatever substrate ... No verdict binding every possible mind is claimed." AGENTS.md: "the ethics claims no warrant binding every possible mind". GOALS (restated 30 October with Ren's approval): "State the ethics as life's ... with no claim to bind every possible mind. Whether a stronger, universal warrant exists stays an open question the ethics does not wait on." The record universal-practical-warrant is an open question that "the ethics, life's stance, does not wait on". The sentence does name both premises by role (scope: the one step; order: C), which is current. Its gloss of C as what anyone who counts everything positively "already holds" is a little stronger than 07 §4.4: every positive weighting ranks the widening higher, "and calling it better is C"; monotonicity at the standpoint is "C's premise relocated".
older.note: [^ethics] opens "**Open: this is the claim the work sets out to prove.**" That standing label is itself older: since 30 October the work no longer sets out to prove a verdict binding every possible mind, and the goal was restated. A later sentence of the note is current: "That all ethics rests on this ground is not proved, and the theory claims no verdict binding every possible mind: T8 states the direction as life's". The note's opening changes on the AI side alongside the proposal.
older.severity: contradiction a reader of the body alone would take away
older.proposal: Change "is offered as the basis of all ethics, for all beings, in all universes." to "is offered as the basis of ethics for life, for every being whose own line runs through life, in all universes." Nothing else in the sentence changes.

older.sentence: It has been reasoned and articulated across cultures, and it draws a line exactly, the line I call the line between good and evil.
older.current_terms: LW (30 October): no absolute good against evil; the ethics is life's. T8 in its stance form; T8's falsifier now reads "a pure closing argued good for life". In Ren's own words (sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-30-no-absolute-good-the-way-for-life.md): "I think there is no absolute universal good vs evil - it is just for us as life". The line itself (widening, narrowing, mixed) is proved with no premise. That widening is better is C, a premise for order; calling the line good and evil is a reading.
older.note: [^good-evil] opens "**The boundaries are proved; under the continuation condition they cover everything; calling them good and evil is a reading.**" It gives the sentence's standing (a reading) but nowhere scopes good and evil to life, so the absolute reading stands. The same applies to paragraph 17's "We need to do good, not evil.", which needs no change once this line is scoped.
older.severity: contradiction a reader of the body alone would take away
older.proposal: "...and it draws a line exactly, the line I call, for life, the line between good and evil."

older.sentence: In ours, read as available work, nothing gives back more than it takes by the second law, and the least loss holds wherever each exchange that takes forgets something of what it held.
older.current_terms: DF1b (26 October; record least-loss-from-entropy-production): "Landauer's bound is not a floor of destroyed exergy by itself: it bounds the heat an erasure exports, and erasure can be thermodynamically reversible". The least loss holds where each taking exchange destroys at least a floor of exergy (`dissipative_of_floor`), or, with whole units, where each taking exchange is irreversible (`dissipative_of_irreversible`). The body's "forgets" came from the earlier reading, in study BECOMING-RENEWAL-READING: "since there the second law and Landauer's bound make it lose available work".
older.note: [^conditions] opens "**Proved under conditions.**" It already states the correction: "though Landauer's bound is no such floor by itself (it bounds the heat an erasure exports, and an erasure can be thermodynamically reversible); with whole units, irreversibility of each taking exchange suffices (`dissipative_of_irreversible`)". The body still says forgetting is enough.
older.severity: contradiction a reader of the body alone would take away
older.proposal: Replace "forgets something of what it held" with "cannot be undone": "...and the least loss holds wherever each exchange that takes cannot be undone." The whole-unit premise stays in the note.

older.sentence: That takes one step, which the work states as a condition and does not assert: for anything, not just oneself, its continuation into the future has significance. [...] Whether the law takes this step for us too is our first open question.
older.current_terms: 07 §4.6 (after version 12): "Under P1–P4, one's concern for one's own continuation reaches everything downstream of what one conditions ... past the end of one's organism ... It needs no step of invariance"; "What the path does not reach ... These remain the step's"; "P2 and P4 are the crux". T8: "Without the step of invariance, §4.6's path carries one's concern ... part of the condition's scope; what that path does not reach is the step's." 07 §1: no statement reading only the represented dynamics entails the condition (`ReadsOnlyDynamics.not_entails`), by construction of the representation, which does not show that becoming leaves significance undetermined. On the root, held de se, the condition is «续无外», and which class a center's own line runs under is open. A warrant binding every possible mind stays an open question the ethics does not wait on. So the step is no longer the only route to others counting, and the open question is how far the law reaches without it.
older.note: [^axiom] opens "**The continuation condition, and where it stands.** No law of the dynamics mentions significance". It states the step and its standpoint form, but it says nothing of §4.6's path, P2 or P4, or that the ethics does not wait on a universal warrant. Its "Open:" list ("the warrant of the condition and of its step of invariance, and the warrant of C; and the attempt with no axiom at all ... has not yet begun") is older too. The note gains these on the AI side alongside the proposal.
older.severity: contradiction a reader of the body alone would take away (in part: the body makes the step the only route)
older.proposal: Leave the first sentence as it is. Change the paragraph's last sentence to "Whether the law takes this step for us too, and how far, is our first open question."

older.sentence: None of this needs an axiom, not even those most mathematics takes for granted: each law is proved from how the theory represents a world and from the conditions it names, stated openly as its premises, each shown holding in one world and failing in another, in a form any mind, human or machine, can check for itself.
older.current_terms: AGENTS.md and 08 §3: an empty axiom report means no `propext`, `Quot.sound` or `Classical.choice`. "The report concerns logic only and says nothing about modelling choices (discrete steps, natural-number amounts, Prop-valued activity), where the real assumptions lie." The release gate never cuts "what it shows and what it does not". 08 §12: "zero axiom" means no substantive axiom, and it is a target. Paragraph 3's second-law sentence rests on the periphery module `EntropyProduction`, whose declarations use the three standard axioms.
older.note: [^proof] opens "**Proved, with what "no axiom" means.**" It says an empty axiom report is not an absence of premises and lists the representation's commitments: "'None of this needs an axiom' says this, and no more. Periphery modules outside the core may use Lean's classical axioms." [^conditions] names `EntropyProduction`'s axioms. The twenty-first review (A-UNIFICATION, caveat i) flagged the body for this.
older.severity: wording older but corrected by its note
older.proposal: "None of this, save the reading of our physics, needs an axiom of logic, not even those most mathematics takes for granted: each law is proved from how the theory represents a world, where its real assumptions lie, and from the conditions it names, stated openly as its premises, ..." The rest of the sentence is unchanged.

older.sentence: Nor are these laws of a world made for them alone: they hold, as theorems, of systems defined without them, every place/transition net among them, and so of every reaction counted in whole molecules, each premise following from the net's own firing rule or stated as a property of the net that anyone can check.
older.current_terms: 08 §2: "A sentence states what the Lean proves, with its hypotheses, no stronger and no weaker." That every reaction is covered is a modelling correspondence, not a theorem; "and so" makes it read as one.
older.note: [^proof] opens "**Proved, with what "no axiom" means.**" Its part on reactions says: "a reaction network counted in whole molecules is a place/transition net ... that is a modelling correspondence, not a theorem." (The note has said so since version 9; this is a standing overreach, not a later revision.)
older.severity: wording older but corrected by its note
older.proposal: Replace "and so of every reaction counted in whole molecules" with "and, read as such nets, of every reaction counted in whole molecules".

older.sentence: What an act does beyond all that never comes back to the selection, whatever it selects for; and where the selection is optimized to the full, it draws down whatever lies beyond and shares what it rewards, to the least any outcome leaves, breaking every dependence there that any outcome breaks.
older.current_terms: The deciding hypothesis is room. One page: "with room, an optimum drains what lies beyond as far as any choice it has would"; T3: "optimization drains what lies beyond its couplings where that gives room". `Optimum.least_iff` holds "exactly where lowering it leaves room". The release gate never cuts a deciding hypothesis.
older.note: [^alignment] opens "**The laws it starts from are proved; the direction is argued under conditions; that it is the foundation is a judgment.**" Its passage on how hard alignment is states the room condition: "holds each condition beyond at the least level any eligible outcome leaves, exactly where lowering it leaves room".
older.severity: wording older but corrected by its note
older.proposal: Insert ", where that gives room,": "...it draws down whatever lies beyond, where that gives room, and shares what it rewards, ..."

older.sentence: Where they agree most is the one step the law has not yet taken for us: do not do to others what you would not want done to yourself (己所不欲，勿施于人); love your neighbor as yourself; love for your brother what you love for yourself.
older.current_terms: Under P1–P4 the law now takes part of the step's work (07 §4.6), and the remainder stays the step's. The laws of the dynamics alone do not entail the condition (07 §1). "Not yet" reads as if the law has taken none of it.
older.note: [^sages] opens "**A reading.**" It covers the reciprocity reading but not how far the law takes the step.
older.proposal: "...the one step the law has not yet taken for us in full: ..." This matches the "how far" in item 4.

older.sentence: I take it to be the truth, the dharma, the Dao.
older.current_terms: "It" is the law together with the two premises. The theory asserts neither premise, and since LW the stance is life's (T8: "For life, the way is 生生"). As a first-person conviction the sentence is allowed (README-LEAD: "The opening above states a conviction in the first person"). Without a scope, it reads as an absolute.
older.note: No note of its own. The next note, [^dao], opens "**A reading.**" and gives the standing, but not the scope. The sentence needs no change if item 1 lands, since "it" then carries "for life".
older.proposal: No change if item 1 lands. Otherwise: "I take it to be the truth, the dharma, the Dao: the way for life."

older.sentence: What closes draws more from what others need than it gives back, beyond what there was to spare; evil is a part that enlarges itself so, closing the world of others.
older.current_terms: The method is relational: no name sets up an independent entity (AGENTS.md, "Begin with one relational unfolding"). LW's reading notes that an absolute good set against an absolute evil "is a frame a totalizing self uses: it draws the other as evil and closes it". The law concerns a net draw beyond the margin, a course, not a kind of part.
older.note: [^good-evil] opens "**The boundaries are proved; under the continuation condition they cover everything; calling them good and evil is a reading.**" It adds: "that evil is a part enlarging itself so is the reading, for the laws ask no self-enlargement."
older.proposal: "evil is a part's enlarging itself so, closing the world of others."

older.sentence: It drops the rest: what that continuation depends on, and that the continuation of others matters too.
older.current_terms: "The rest" is part of "the truth with much of it abstracted away", so the sentence counts the continuation condition among truths. The account states the condition and asserts neither premise, and paragraph 6 of the body says the same ("which the work states as a condition and does not assert").
older.note: No note of its own. The paragraph's notes, [^own] ("**A reading.**") and [^cancer] ("**The mechanism is proved under conditions; the diagnosis is a judgment.**"), do not address it. [^own] also grounds own significance in the condition rather than in P1, the self's presupposition, which is older on the AI side.
older.proposal: "It drops the rest: what that continuation depends on, and the one step, that the continuation of others matters too."

older.sentence: *Each note says how far its sentence is proved: proved, proved under conditions, a reading, or a judgment.*
older.current_terms: The notes also give the standings premise ([^axiom]), thesis (T1, T3, T5, T6, T7), conviction ([^turn]) and open ([^ethics]). 08 §2's labels include conditional, thesis and open, and the release gate lists "proved, premise, reading or conjecture".
older.note: No note; this is the body's own key to the notes.
older.proposal: "*Each note says how far its sentence is proved: proved, proved under conditions, a premise stated and not asserted, a thesis, a reading, a judgment, or open.*"

older.sentence: Wherever becoming can be told in steps and counted amounts, in any universe, nothing that unfolds can break them, because they are what coming to be and ceasing to be are.
older.current_terms: Since RA (23 October) the root has been the grammar: a relation read as condition, and a class, with laws "for every relation and every class"; the World, with amounts and discrete steps, is one of its models (GLOSSARY, 01 §8). The counting laws the paragraph cites need steps but no amounts. Not wrong, only narrower than the account.
older.note: [^law] opens "**Proved with no premise about the unfolding, and at the exact boundary where it can hold.**" It says "Each commitment of the representation is either not needed or needed exactly" and "*Amounts:* activity and dependence read no amount". It does not mention the root.
older.proposal: Optional: "Wherever becoming can be told in steps, in any universe, ..." (drop "and counted amounts"). Paragraph 3 brings in amounts itself.

draftB_agent.choices:
COUNT. The draft is 148 words by the render's own rule: visible prose only, link targets dropped, and words matched by navigation.py's regex, which counts "17–22" as two words and "AI-written" as one. At the slow rate that is 1.48 minutes, so {{time:screen}} prints "a minute". At 150 words it would print "1–2 minutes". The template form below also renders at 148.

PLACEMENT AND FIELDS. In this worktree, tools/research/navigation.py has uncommitted changes from another session (not mine), and so does tools/research/tests/test_featured_results.py. In those changes, first_screen() places the readme_lead file before the opening and fills these fields: {{time:PATH}}, {{time:opening}}, {{time:notes}}, {{time:screen}}, {{count:registered}} and {{count:STATUS}].

- The draft above is the rendered form, with links relative to the repository root.
- The source form for _process/README-LEAD.md has the same text with ../../ links and the fields. It is saved at /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-ren-theories/4cd2c9b9-8aca-4fd1-99bb-ff1a3f9d1698/scratchpad/fs/README-LEAD.template.md.
- Field mapping:
  - 475 = {{count:recorded-checked}}
  - 506 = {{count:registered}}
  - 17–22 = {{time:theories/becoming/ONE-PAGE.md}}
  - 104–135 = {{time:theories/becoming/THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md}}
  - 19–25 = {{time:opening}}
  - notes = {{time:notes}}. Measured by the same rule on today's README, this renders "78–101 minutes". The given "about 80–100" rounds it. The draft keeps the given figure; the template prints the field. Both are six words.
- #truth-exists and #notes are fragment links, which adapt_links leaves unchanged. README has one "### Notes" heading.

FIGURES LEFT OUT. "20 reviewed at their stated scope" and "4 open" are left out for length. They are on the register's first line, which the 506 links to. I also dropped "Eight" before "theses": it would be a count copied from 08 §9, not rendered from a source.

NEVER-CUT ITEMS THE DRAFT TOUCHES, ALL KEPT:
- Both premises with their roles, in current terms: the condition for scope ("whose losses count") and C, which alone gives order.
- What is not claimed: neither premise is asserted; their warrant is open; no warrant binding every possible mind is claimed; no human has reviewed the work.
- Standings:
  - the ethics' results are theorems under the premises each names. I wrote "each names", not "under them", because practical judgment also uses A, L and the practical commitments;
  - 475 results have a Lean receipt;
  - the theses are tested and failed in part.
- A failure as it fell: kept as "some passed, some failed", with a link to the table where each verdict stands as it fell.

NEVER-CUT ITEMS NOT TOUCHED:
- A deciding hypothesis: the draft states no law.
- An AI label on a reading: the draft contains no reading.
- An empty axiom report: the draft does not cite one.

So no excess is recorded.

CONDITION 1 (ONE TEXT, NOT TWO). I cut everything the body already says in other words:
- "the laws evaluate nothing": the body has "no law of the dynamics says whether that matters";
- "each law proved from its premises": the body has "proved from how the theory represents a world and from the conditions it names";
- each sentence's standing in its note: the body's italic line says it;
- nets, alignment, the self.

Two overlaps remain:
- The definition reuses the verbs of the body's first sentence. It is the theory's standard one-line definition, also used on the one page and the overview, and it adds what the body does not say: one relational unfolding, life and evaluation, and not assuming becoming is good.
- The premises are restated by name, which condition 1 allows.

This makes the current README-LEAD.md redundant. Its first paragraph and its list of four layers say what the block says, and its bridge sentence, "The opening above…", would be wrong once the lead sits before the opening. The draft replaces it, and the old text should go to history by `research.py move`. Its pure-core sentence then leaves the README. If the coordinator wants an empty axiom report cited on the screen, the never-cut caveat adds about 19 words and puts the screen 17 over budget, with the excess recorded: "The pure core's empty axiom reports concern logic only, not modelling choices such as discrete steps and whole-number amounts."

The chapters, the register page and the theory graph are not linked as layers, for three reasons: no reading time was given for them, the navigation line already links Chapters and Results, and the one page links the theory graph. The 中文 links are omitted (they would cost 2 words), because the one page and the overview each link their Chinese edition in their first line.

CONDITION 2 (NEVER CONTRADICT; PROPOSE WHERE THE BODY IS OLDER). One place in the body is worded older than the current terms. The body says "is offered as the basis of all ethics, for all beings, in all universes", and "the line I call the line between good and evil". The current terms come from AGENTS.md and LW, 30 October: no warrant binding every possible mind is claimed; the direction is life's; the scope stays the condition's. On 30 October Ren wrote "there is no absolute universal good vs evil - it is just for us as life". The draft states the current term. That does not contradict an offer, but the two sit in tension.

A proposal to OPENING should go alongside:
- Replace "the basis of all ethics, for all beings, in all universes" with "the basis of ethics for life, for all beings whose own line runs through life, in all universes". This changes only whose way the ethics is; every continuation's losses still count.
- Optionally, write "the line I call, for life, the line between good and evil".

The body stays unchanged until Ren answers. I checked the rest of the body against the current terms and found no other conflict. The one-axiom framing is gone. "Whether the law takes this step for us too is our first open question" matches note [^axiom].

AI LABEL. The block is visibly marked "AI-written", as asked and as AGENTS.md requires: Ren's words are kept apart from AI elaboration, and the one page already uses "an AI reading". This is in tension with the 19 October front-page rule ("don't mention ai, me, or you"). The alternative, a label only in the file's HTML comment, would not mark the screen for readers. The coordinator should settle which.

I checked it was byte-identical to the scratch file, removed it at once and confirmed it was gone. I made no other writes outside the scratchpad, and nothing in the repository was edited or committed.

per_draft.four_points: All four are there: what it is (first sentence), what is tested, the two premises, where to start. The order is not the coordinator's (what it is, premises, start, tested): 'tested' comes second. 'What is tested' covers only the Lean proofs. It does not say that the theses about actual systems are tested, or how those tests fell, so a cold reader takes 'tested' to mean 'proved'.
per_draft.contradicts_body: No direct contradiction. One clash of terms: the body says each law is proved 'from how the theory represents a world and from the conditions it names, stated openly as its premises', keeping the representation apart from the premises, and [^proof] does the same. A calls the representation's commitments 'premises of the laws that use them'. A reader then expects discrete steps to be stated hypotheses, each shown holding and failing, and they are not. A's axiom-report sentence corrects the body's older 'None of this needs an axiom' (auditor item 5) as the note does, which is allowed. A says nothing on the auditor's most serious item (the body's 'basis of all ethics, for all beings, in all universes'), so the first screen sends the reader into that absolute wording with no current term ahead of it.
per_draft.duplicates_body: 'each note gives its sentence's standing' repeats the body's own first line ('*Each note says how far its sentence is proved*'). Cut it. The axiom-report sentence restates paragraph 4 and [^proof] in other words, but it is the 'tested' point and corrects older wording, so it is allowed. A bigger problem: the whole block nearly copies the first paragraph of README-LEAD (the what-it-is sentence, the Lean and axiom-report sentence, the premises sentence, 'states a conviction').
